notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
smbclient connects to a specific SMB share for file browsing and transfer. Interactive session provides ls, get, put, mget commands. With null session (-U '' -N), accesses shares that permit unauthenticated connection.

=== CHAINING ===
cme or smbmap identifies READ/WRITE shares → smbclient connects → browse contents → get sensitive files (configs, scripts, credentials) → put files if WRITE access + escalation path exists.

=== FILE TRANSFER ===
mget * downloads all files from current directory. recurse ON + prompt OFF → mget * downloads entire share tree recursively.
